headline: Kim Jong Un crosses into China via new bridge in Dandong
summary: The North Korean leader's visit comes as both nations aim to rejuvenate trade and commerce through the newly opened New Yalu River Bridge.
details: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un arrived in China on Saturday, entering the neighbouring country via the newly opened New Yalu River Bridge in the border city of Dandong.
Chinese Premier Li Qiang met Kim in the border city, according to South Korean officials. The visit occurs just one day before the anniversary of China joining the Korean War (1950-1953).

The 3-km (2-mile) New Yalu River Bridge is the most significant land border crossing between the two nations. It was opened this month after long delays to boost trade and commerce following pandemic-related disruptions.
Experts suggest the bridge will resolve major logistics bottlenecks, allowing for the movement of heavy equipment, raw materials, and energy products essential for North Korea's development.

The visit signals warming ties between Beijing and Pyongyang, following two summits between their leaders in the past 13 months. Kim's last known visit to China was in September 2025 for Victory Day celebrations.
While China remains Pyongyang's main economic and diplomatic backer, analysts note that North Korea has drawn closer to Russia since 2022, potentially reducing its reliance on Beijing.

headline: 9 Fire Service units control blaze at Gazipur carton factory
summary: The fire broke out at the Supreme Garments carton factory in Kashimpur, fueled by a large quantity of empty cartons.
details: A fire at a carton factory in the Kashimpur area of Gazipur was brought under control after approximately three and a half hours of firefighting efforts.
The blaze broke out around 10:30 am at the carton factory of Supreme Garments in the Shailan area, under the jurisdiction of Kashimpur Police Station.
Nine units of the Fire Service worked to extinguish the flames, eventually bringing the situation under control by 1:50 pm.
According to officials, the fire intensified rapidly due to the large quantity of empty cartons stored inside the facility.
No casualties have been reported so far, and the exact cause of the fire remains unknown.
caption:
A massive fire ripped through a carton factory in Gazipur this morning, fueled by piles of empty cartons.

A fire at a carton factory in the Kashimpur area of Gazipur was brought under control after approximately three and a half hours of firefighting efforts.

The blaze broke out around 10:30 am at the carton factory of Supreme Garments in the Shailan area, under the jurisdiction of Kashimpur Police Station.

Nine units of the Fire Service worked to extinguish the flames, eventually bringing the situation under control by 1:50 pm.

According to officials, the fire intensified rapidly due to the large quantity of empty cartons stored inside the facility.

No casualties have been reported so far, and the exact cause of the fire remains unknown.
